purpose: Recognize tips and commissions with explicit beneficiary policy, deterministic calculation evidence, and matching participant payables without pretending either is a payment settlement.
invariants: staff tips identify one beneficiary and create an equal expense payable
tenant-income tips create no participant payable
percentage commission equals basis amount times rate divided by 100
fixed commission basis equals recognized commission amount
earning and payable tenant organization currency amount beneficiary and recognition date match
source authority is tenant and organization scoped
event outbox journal and payable commit or roll back together
replay is idempotent and conflicting reuse is rejected
tips and commissions do not create payment settlement evidence
